description: This Dart file defines the AppTheme class which provides theme configurations for a Flutter application, including color schemes, text styles, and widget themes. It centralizes style definitions for consistent UI appearance across the app.

classes.name: AppTheme
classes.description: Contains static methods and properties to generate and access theme data and color schemes for the app.

classes.name: _AppColors
classes.description: Provides color tokens used throughout the theme, including brand colors, backgrounds, and status indicators.

methods.name: AppTheme.colors
methods.description: Getter that provides an instance of _AppColors containing the color palette.

methods.name: AppTheme.darkTheme
methods.description: Static getter returning a ThemeData object configured with dark mode styles aligned with the app's branding.
